_comment: Copy to destinations.json (gitignored) and fill in real ids.
Names must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$ — no ':' (it is the batch queue separator).
chat_id: numeric id, or @publicchannelname. Add the bot to the group FIRST;
a bot that is not a member gets 'Bad Request: chat not found'.
Basic groups have ids like -5076421920. Supergroups and channels are prefixed
with -100 (e.g. -1001234567890) — do not add that prefix yourself, read the real
id from the chat. Promoting a group to a supergroup CHANGES its id.
thread_id: optional, forum supergroups only, targets one topic.
bot: optional, name of an extra bot from TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN_<NAME>. Without it,
the default bot posts. The token never goes in this file. THAT bot is the one
that has to be a member of the chat.
'default' is optional — without it, TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID is used.

deploys.description: the Deploys topic inside the infra supergroup

grupo-do-agente.description: posts as the agent's own bot, which is the one in that group
